title: Results site before the review-driven redesign

changes.text: FMAM 2026 March, April and May verified against official CHIRPS v2.0 observations.
ONDJ shown on the ONDJ R3 (Deyr) rainfall domain (575 cells) instead of the earlier >=120 mm / 20% rule.

title: Redesign around the reader: one cycle selector, outlook first, verification narrative

changes.text: Cycle and area selectors drive every section; shareable view links; outlook and map first; status panel with precise target statuses; verification narrative and paired anomaly chart; per-cycle CSV downloads.

title: Area-specific historical skill and clearer uncertainty

changes.text: Historical skill computed for each cycle's rainfall domain and the R0-R3 regions from stored cross-validated probabilities (no refitting).

Skill labels reflect intervals and Holm-adjusted p-values; verification narrative always reports the rainfall error; climatology defined as observed tercile frequencies; unavailable verification explained; separate verification panels.

title: Historical verification explorer, forecast-and-evidence package, map comparison and release archive

changes.text: Historical diagnostics per cycle, target and area: performance by year, reliability diagrams, probability histograms and category Brier skill (cross-validated and exploratory).

PDF bulletin and one-click ZIP package per cycle; side-by-side forecast vs observed anomaly maps; release archive and change log; research label on phones; keyboard focus kept when leaving an unavailable view.

title: Comparison with official outlooks (ICPAC OND 2026 update, EMI Bega 2026/27)

changes.text: New pipeline: ICPAC and EMI products discovered, downloaded and versioned by content hash; standardized records; comparison with the native ONDJ forecast; rule-based interpretation. Comparison numbers are published only after a person reviews the extracted values.
Outlooks section shows the official figures, the providers' own text, source records and the status of each comparison; ONDJ gallery links the review report.

title: Reviewed comparison with official outlooks published

changes.text: EMI zone values and the digitized ICPAC map were reviewed by the project team; the comparison findings, numbers and maps are now published (agreement in the south and south-east, disagreement in EMI zone III).
